name: Introduction to Climate Change
description:
Introduction to the climate system with particular focus on energy balance and the role of the
CO2 and other greenhouse gases; introduction to simple climate models; hands-on experiments
with online climate models to understand the role of different factors; evidence of changing
climate in observations from satellites and meteorological stations; causes of climate change;
future climate projections; impacts of climate change on various sectors; adaptation and
mitigation of climate change; elements of an effective response to climate change.
